motions.motion_text: Council Member Pass moved, seconded by Council Member Bankobian to approve Consent Agenda Items 3A-3K with Item 3C as amended.

Council Member Jones moved, seconded by Council Member Morzel to approve Ordinance No. 739 amending Chapter 7-6 "Parking Infractions" B.R.C. 1981 by adding a new Section 7-6-30 prohibiting the parking by non-electric vehicles at electric vehicle charging stations, amending Section 7-6-2 by adding a penalty of $20 and setting forth detailed definitions as amended in the staff memo and by a friendly amendment to change the fee to $30.
Council Members Jones and Morzel agreed to amend their motion to raise the penalty to $50.

Council Member Cowles moved, seconded by Council Member Morzel, to approve Ordinance No. 7962 amending Chapter 6-3, "Trash, Recyclables and Compostables," B.R.C. 1981, by adding a new section 6-3-12 requiring bear-resistant containers in a designated area of the city, amending Section 6-3-2, by adding new definitions, adding administrative practices for violations, amending Section 6-12-5, "Containers for Recycling or Composting Operations," by adding further related details as amended by ordinance that states the hearing officer may dismiss the matter based on evidence presented at a hearing plus in accordance with Section 14-1 of the Revised Code of Laws.
Council Member Pass moved seconded by Council Member Jones to approve the proposed changes to the Legislative Agenda.
There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED on March 5, 2014 at 10:16 PM.
motions.vote_text: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED on March 5, 2014 at 10:16 PM.
